BL-1566 — An Article 4.2 hold is a durable record QA resumes from: QA withheld BL-1555's approval on an unowned red and completed the parcel; when the owner BL-1564 was minted and the resume note reached QA (001539, 12:16Z) it was completed in ten seconds with nothing to resume, and the swarm starved at cap 1 until the operator re-sent it - a hold record names the parcel and its reds, the register releases it, every QA turn prints a released hold first, and a note cannot be completed while a released hold is open
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the hold is released by the standing-red register only - every red the hold names has a row whose owner is a ticket in paused/ or active/ (a done/ ticket owns nothing) - never by a note…
BL-1566 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1566" (or "reject BL-1566 <reason>") to act.
